soundness_flags.label: ass:causal-minimality
soundness_flags.one_line: The positive-parent-law-measure nonconstancy condition is stronger than Peters et al.'s standard pointwise nonconstancy characterization of causal minimality, so it cannot retain the standard tag under that name.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Equation (6), Definition 4.1, and Theorem 4.3 on pp. 4--5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper defines the GENE order fitness and proves greedy recovery under its strong/global order-ranking condition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 12, Proposition 17; p. 16, Definition 27 and Theorem 28
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 17 characterizes causal minimality through nonconstancy in each parent argument; Definition 27 requires non-vanishing noise densities and continuous three-times differentiable mechanisms; Theorem 28 gives restricted-ANM identification.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1--2, abstract and introduction; Sections 3 and 5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper introduces scale-invariant R²-sortability and studies its dependence on ANM simulation parameters, rather than the GENE score or local insertion landscape.
The paper analyzes greedy sparsest-permutation walks through DAG-associahedron/covered-arrow structure and gives consistency guarantees for that sparsity objective.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Online Appendix E, Theorem E.2 and Proposition E.3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper treats fitted residuals for dHSIC and describes sample splitting for asymptotically valid testing; it does not provide the proposed residual-coordinate Lipschitz band analysis.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 12, Theorem 6; Section 5 and Appendix C
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For fixed kernels and a fixed null distribution, finite nonzero second moment of the centered product kernel yields a standard-normal limit for studentized cross-HSIC.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 3, equations (1)--(2); pp. 12--13, Theorem 1 and Remark 3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CAM uses independent positive-variance Gaussian errors and separates order estimation from pruning under a wrong-order likelihood-gap condition.
Stone establishes global nonparametric-regression convergence rates under smoothness and regularity conditions on a compact domain.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Either replace ass:causal-minimality with Peters et al.'s pointwise causal-minimality condition, or retag the positive-parent-law-measure strengthening as novel and state why that stronger version is needed for the compact-support bridge.

Give a formal compatibility predicate for propagated HSIC decisions and replace the broad last sentence of the bands theorem by the exact condition under which an unresolved decision forces at least two terminal DAGs.

Test whether the edgewise certificate extends from matching components to a named larger modular graph class, with an explicit interference term; this would turn the sufficient matching result into a stronger class-extension result.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal-minimality assumption tag/formulation, then advance the retained field-tier local-GENE navigation and strict-separation kernel to Stage 0.
